entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: An optional information element that the network may include to request a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed.

entities.name: ESM cause #65
entities.description: ESM cause value #65 indicating 'maximum number of EPS bearers reached'.

entities.name: Procedure retry
entities.description: A procedure that may be retried after a minimum time interval specified by the back-off timer value.

relations.description: The back-off timer value specifies a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed.
The back-off timer value IE is not included if the ESM cause is #65 'maximum number of EPS bearers reached'.
